responses.change: Specified concrete, index-isolated restore algorithm using temporary git index and git checkout-index, with comparison/deletion of checkpoint-absent files. Removed alternative read-tree framing from design, contracts, and tasks.

Specified concrete cross-system rollback procedure: wrap SQLite event write and git update-ref in a SQLite transaction, rolling back on update-ref failure. On SQLite commit failure, run compensating git update-ref -d to delete the orphaned ref.

Added explicit tasks and constraints requiring checkpoint/restore test suites to run within dynamically initialized temporary git repositories ('git init' fixture directories), leaving the host Project Minna repository untouched.
Added an explicit assumption that checkpoints require at least one existing commit in the repository, and unborn-HEAD repositories are unsupported.

Added success criteria SC-005, SC-006, SC-007, and SC-008 to explicitly cover ignored path tolerance, monotonic create-only sequencing, journal logging verification, and fail-closed transaction recovery outcomes.
